Dialogs.Dialog: I was invited to a relative's wedding the other day... The wedding dress was so beautiful...
I bet a dress would look good on ▲高嶺＊＊▲ too.
Huh, me!? D-Do you think so... Thank you. Actually, I caught the bouquet too...
I see. Then ▲高嶺＊＊▲ might be wearing one before long.
Geez... Don't say things like that so casually？
By the way, ▲高嶺＊＊▲ doesn't get tanned, huh？ Even though you practice outside...
Right, maybe it's just me... If I used tanning oil, would I tan nicely？
...You're grinning... You're not thinking something weird, are you？
Huh... No, I'm not lonely, because I'm with you？
I see. I'll never let you feel lonely, okay？
By the way, there was a power outage last night. It was dark and scary...
I see, so ▲高嶺＊＊▲ doesn't like the dark.
Yes, a little... Huh？ Your face is red... A cold？
This is probably because of a dream...
A dream...？ Anyway, let me check your temperature？
My temperature!? I'm fine！ No problem！
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Could you show me your childhood photos sometime？
▲高嶺＊＊▲ and I weren't childhood friends, were we？
Huh!? We met in high school, didn't we？ Did you forget？
(Hmm, I feel like I had a dream like that...)
Has ▲高嶺＊＊▲ ever read Romeo and Juliet？
Of course. If Romeo had been a little more dependable, could they have been happy...
Right. A guy's got to put his body on the line to protect the girl he loves！
Yes, that's right. Someone like that would be wonderful...
By the way, the international doubles championship was on TV the other day, right？
The Japanese players did so well, I got so excited.
Yeah, ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s smash was amazing. Air Mana！ ...Just kidding！
I'm thinking of making sweet potato cakes at home. Would you like some？
Sweet potato... Sounds great, but watch you don't eat too many, okay？
Geez, I'm not that much of a glutton！
Hey. Which does ▲高嶺＊＊▲ like more, sumo or food？
Huh？ Um... Why those two options？
Thanks！ Can I eat it now？
No. It's embarrassing, so put it away.
Mm, good boy. Just kidding. ...Enjoy it slowly at home, okay？
▲主人公＊▲. Hey, come here a sec.
No. It just makes me happy that you're so happy about it.
I'm glad I tried hard... Hehe.
I came to bring you something delicious.
You're welcome. Make sure you savor it.
I, um, just made too much. That's all.
It's wrapped pretty nicely for that, though...
Yeah. Here, this. A return gift for Valentine's.
Hehe, thank you. Wow, it's lovely...！
(Doesn't look like she liked it much...)
This must have taken a while to choose, right？
Hehe. You thought really hard about it. Thank you, I'll treasure it？
Hearing that makes it worth choosing.
Hehe！ ...I bet couples all over the world are having this same conversation, huh？
I'm glad we're one of them. Let's keep it up, okay？
Today's White Day, right. I wanted to give you something for Valentine's.
...Yes. Actually, I was kind of waiting... Just kidding.
Haha, I see. Go ahead and open it.
Wow... I'm so happy！ Thank you... I'll treasure it？
Thank you. For understanding what I like...
...Thank you. Did I make you go to trouble...？
(Doesn't look like she liked it much...)
Did it take a long time to choose？
Hmm, but don't you think that kind of time is fun？
Yes. Time flies when you're imagining the smile of the person you're giving it to.
Exactly. So don't worry about it.
(Seeing her this happy makes it worth choosing.)
Huh. That face... Could it be...
It's March 14th, after all？ I got tired of waiting！ Just kidding.
Hahaha, I see. Sorry to keep you waiting. Here.
You know exactly what I like？ Hehe, thank you！
I kind of like your taste. Thank you.
...Thank you. How should I use this...
(Doesn't look like she liked it much...)
I was a little worried I wouldn't get anything.
No way, of course I'd give you something.
...You're not going around handing them out to other girls too？
Hehe, just kidding. Here's to next year too, okay？
Hehe, good. Next year, the year after, and beyond, okay？
Ah, here. A return gift for Valentine's.
Hehe, lovely. I'm happy, thank you.
Thank you so much. I like this kind of thing.
(Doesn't look like she liked it much...)
Hey, when boys buy things like this, how do you manage？
Some shops are hard for guys to go into, right？
Maybe, but if it makes the person smile, that's no big deal, right？
Hmm... So you picked it hoping I'd smile？
I see. ...Maybe I can let myself hope a little...？
No, never mind. Thank you. I'll treasure this？
(Oh no！ It's White Day, and I didn't get her anything...)
(I'm the biggest idiot in the world！)
(Oh no！ It's White Day, and I didn't get her anything...)
What's wrong？ Staring at me like that. Need something？
No, it's not that I need something, it's that I don't have something...
You don't... I see. Then I'll... get going？
(I'm the biggest idiot in the world！)
(Oh no！ It's White Day, and I didn't get her anything...)
Hey, do you know what day it is today？
(I'm the biggest idiot in the world！)
(Oh no！ It's White Day, and I didn't get her anything...)
...Do you need something？ You look kind of pale.
(I'm the biggest idiot in the world！)
Good morning. How are you feeling？
Good. Since we're on the same team, I'll cheer for you. Do your best.
Hehe. Don't get so fired up you get hurt, and don't forget to warm up, okay？
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ is cheering for me. Let's do this.)
You were amazing！ It surprised me.
Thanks. It must be thanks to ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s cheering.
Eh？ You could hear my voice？
Hehe, maybe I helped a little. If so, I'm happy...
I guess I didn't practice enough... Sorry, after you cheered for me and everything.
Don't worry？ If you gave it everything you had, that's what matters... And you looked wonderful trying so hard.
▲主人公＊▲. I just heard you're in the handsome-guy contest... Is that true？
Ah, yeah, that's right. My friends signed me up without asking...
W-What？ Why are you staring like that？
Sorry. I was just thinking you might actually do pretty well.
The angle matters too. I like you best seen from the front right... I think？
！ Not in a weird way, I mean... an objective opinion？ Yes, that's it！ So don't think about it！
...What if you get popular because of this...
(Taking care of my looks every day paid off...)
Yeah, well... I'm not exactly the handsome type.
No, that's not true！ To me, you're... Oh！
(Maybe I should pay more attention to my looks...)
I think it's normal... but thank you. It's really crowded, isn't it？
Yeah. Maybe it would've been better with just the two of us...
Geez, don't say that so loud. ...Though I agree...
I have a present for you.
Oh, thanks！ I have one too.
Lovely... You have such good taste. Thank you, I'll treasure it？
Hehe, it's kind of cute. Thank you.
Hey, this is... No, never mind. Thank you.
(Doesn't look like she liked it much...)
(Oops, should I have gotten her a present？)
Hey, would you... come somewhere with me for a bit...？
▲高嶺＊＊▲ in a dress... It suits you.
Do you think so？ Thank you. But I'm glad you came. I was looking for you.
No. At times like this, you're the one I want beside me... Just saying.
Oh, thanks！ I've got one ready too.
...You're like a magician. Thank you, I'll treasure it forever？
I kind of like this sort of thing. Thank you very much.
...Thank you. ...Hey, is this kind of thing popular right now？
(Doesn't look like she liked it much...)
Haha, presents？ Santa doesn't come to my place anymore.
(Oops, should I have gotten her a present？)
Hey, is it okay if you come somewhere with me after this？
I should get home, it's getting late.
Merry Christmas. ▲高嶺＊＊▲ in a dress, of course. It suits you.
But how'd you find me in this crowd？
I'm confident I could find you anywhere？ Aren't you？
O-Of course I could... I think？
Your eyes are darting around？ Hehe！
Oh, thanks. I've got one for you too.
Wow, it's lovely... Thank you, I'll treasure it！
Um... Thank you. I'll try to learn to like it？
(Doesn't look like she liked it much...)
Hm, does Santa still come to ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s house？ Haha.
(Oops, should I have gotten her a present？)
Will you come with me after this？ There's a place I want you to go with me.
I'll head home？ It's getting late.
A party like this is nice once in a while, isn't it？
Yeah. Huh... The dress looks great, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. It really suits you.
...Really？ I don't think it's anything special.
No, it's really nice. More than usual, how do I put it...
More importantly, look... There's delicious-looking food over there. Let's go get some？
Even a tree you're used to looks different lit up.
Yes. With this many lights, maybe the tree's warm too？
Hahaha, good point. Is ▲高嶺＊＊▲ cold？
I'm fine？ I don't look it, but I'm tough against the cold.
You're cold, right？ Come here？ I'll warm your hands.
Let's stay like this a little？ ...I'm so happy...
(Yeah. Just snuggled up holding hands... and that's all it takes.)
Yeah. It really feels like Christmas.
Hehe, it does. It's a view you can only see this time of year.
Still, it's cold... ▲高嶺＊＊▲, are you okay？
Um, I have a favor to ask... Is that okay？
Um. Can I borrow your pocket？
...Yeah, right. Please, come in. I'm afraid there's not much to offer.
Hey, let's walk home slowly？ I want to be with you a little longer...
Yeah, me too. Let's take our time.
(Just walking hand in hand... and it's such a happy Christmas.)
Hahaha, your eyes lit up. Want to get closer？
...Oh. Hey, can you see the very top of the tree？
Sure, leave it to... Wait, that's impossible！
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ is so excited. She's like a kid.)
And I'm happy. Side by side with the person I love on Christmas Eve... Isn't it like a scene from a movie？
But something's missing, don't you think？
Yes. Both my hands are free, you know？
Both of mine are free too, you know？
...Geez. Then, may I borrow your arm？
Of course. Here you go, princess.
Hehe. Hey, let's take the long way home today？
(Just being together like this makes me so happy...)
Brr, cold... She should be here soon.
Happy New Year, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Here's to another year.
A kimono, huh. It suits you.
Then let's go make our New Year's shrine visit.
Of course, it's New Year's. What a crowd.
...I'll hold it for you. So you don't get lost.
If you don't hurry, I'll leave you behind, okay？
Oh, r-right！ Um, thank you very much.
What should I wish for this year...
Nope. It's a tough one... ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ Already decided？
Mine's always the same. "May I always be happy with the people I love."
Hmm, I wonder？ Oh, look, it's cleared a little. Let's go？
Thanks for walking me home. See you later.
Here's to many more years together.
Of course, same here. See you.
Then let's go to the shrine.
Oh, candy apples！ Candied mandarins too！
Go for it, Daddy'll buy you anything！
Then chocolate bananas and candied apricots too！
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ is in a great mood.)
Why does festival food taste so good, I wonder？
Yes. And I can eat way more than I think. It's dangerous... No more eating for today.
▲高嶺＊＊▲. Look, butter potatoes, in season. Oh, grilled squid over there... And cotton candy too, look！
Oh. The firework that just went up...
Nothing. I hope more go up...
Yeah... Oh, over there. Looks empty. Let's go.
...Now we know why there's no one here.
...Yeah. I didn't think we'd only be able to hear the fireworks...
What should we do？ Go back？
Hmm. If ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is okay with it, why don't we stay？ The night view's pretty.
...Actually, I was thinking the same. Besides... I get to relax with you.
Yeah. Hey, how about we do fireworks, just the two of us, some other time？
That sounds nice. I want to do sparklers.
Are you listening？ ...What？ Why are you staring？
I was thinking ▲高嶺＊＊▲ watching fireworks is pretty too.
You know？ When you tell me how you feel so casually like that... it makes me so happy.
But I want to talk about the fireworks with you later... so watch them properly too. Just kidding.
I am watching. Along with ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
I kind of want to try it.
Don't tell me, your first time？
...It's not. I was good at it in grade school. That one, right？ You aim at... some thing on the shelf.
Yeah, that's it！ All right, let's have a contest！
...Um. Hey！ For a beginner who couldn't even load the cork, that was a great effort！
...The guns were shaped differently back when I was good. And there was nothing I wanted anyway.
Thanks for walking me home. ...You're so kind.
Then shall we go to the Bay Bridge？
Oh. The firework that just went up...
Nothing. I hope more go up...
Are you listening？ ...What？ Why are you staring？
I was thinking ▲高嶺＊＊▲ watching fireworks is pretty too.
You know？ When you tell me how you feel so casually like that... it makes me so happy.
But I want to talk about the fireworks with you later... so watch them properly too. Just kidding.
I am watching. Along with ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Thanks for walking me home. ...You're so kind.
...This is nice after all. With school, I get to see you every day...
Nothing！ Here's to this term too？
Well, sure. Is ▲高嶺＊＊▲ not happy？
Not really. Because once break starts...
...Nothing. I wish break would hurry up and end...
Your test results were great！ We could be good rivals, couldn't we？
When you say that, it makes me want to try harder.
Hehe, I can't fall behind either... Here's to us？
(This time's tests were neither good nor bad... Average.)
I think you can aim higher. And I'm not just being biased.
...I want you to get up close to my name, so do your best？
(All right. I'll try harder next time.)
(The tests were a disaster this time...)
...Hey, if there's anything you don't get, ask me？ No need to hold back.
That's about all I can do... but I think I can help a little. So.
(I made her worry... Ugh, I really need to work harder...)
▲高嶺＊＊▲... Y-Yeah. A little. Or, uh, raring to go？ Maybe？
Hehe, calm down？ I'll teach you a good charm. It's proven to work, so don't worry. Slowly, close your eyes？
Huh？ Ah, I think I'm ready...
Hehe, good. Give it everything you've got？ I'll cheer with everything I've got too.
(That thing just now melted my nerves！ All right, let's do this！)
Thanks. It's thanks to ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s cheering.
...I'm happy you say that. But I think it was really your skill.
You were amazing. I couldn't take my eyes off you... Rest up today, okay？
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ is happy too. I'm glad I won.)
Sorry, after you cheered for me.
No, don't worry. I think it was a good match...
But I understand how frustrating it is. So rest for now？
(I wanted to show ▲高嶺＊＊▲ my good side...)
...Can't I come give my boyfriend a birthday present？
Oh right, today's my birthday. Thanks！
Hehe, geez... Don't forget my birthday like that, okay？
So, here's your present. Will you take it？
Something from ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ Never. Not even if heaven and earth turned upside down.
Geez, why do you always say such smooth things？
Hehe, but I'll take it that you're really happy. Happy birthday.
Yes. Today's your birthday, right？ So, this...
You're welcome. If you don't like it, tell me？ You can give it back.
There's no way I wouldn't like a present ▲高嶺＊＊▲ picked out.
Is it okay to say that before you've even seen it？
Hehe. I'm happy you say that.
Then once more. Happy birthday. Let's make it a wonderful year？
You forgot your own birthday？ I see... Then I won't give you this.
Hold on！ I want it！ The present！
Hehehe！ Then will you promise me？ That you won't forget my birthday！
What was that pause？ ...Hehe, but I'll forgive you.
It's the wonderful day you were born, after all？ Here you go.
Yes. Happy birthday. I hope it's a good year for you.
Today's your birthday, right？ So, this.
You remembered... I'm so happy, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
...G-Geez, don't make such a big fuss. Come on, put it away quickly？
...Happy birthday. I hope I can celebrate again next year...
I wanted to give you this. Happy birthday！
Ah... Thank you！ Hey, can I open it？
Oh, this... I wanted this！ You're amazing, thank you.
(Doesn't look like she liked it much...)
Still, you're in way too much of a rush？ What if you tripped and got hurt？
Geez... I really can't take my eyes off you.
S-Sorry. I just wanted to see ▲高嶺＊＊▲ as soon as I could.
That feeling... really makes me so happy, but...
Think about how I'd worry, too.
As long as you understand, that's fine.
...But if I saw you, I might run too.
It's ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s birthday today, right？ Here, a present.
You remembered... I'm so happy, thank you. Can I open it？
Wow... I was looking for this！ I'm so happy. Thank you！
Thank you. What a lovely present.
...Thank you. It's the thought that counts, right？
(Doesn't look like she liked it much...)
Yes. Next is your birthday, right？ Hey, what do you want？
Being told happy birthday by the person I love like this... and even getting a present.
It'd be easy to take it for granted, but I think it's such a happy thing.
Here's to us from now on, too.
(Next year, the year after, I want to keep celebrating ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s birthday together...)
Hehe, what is it？ That face. You look so goofy？
Hahaha... I just wanted to give you this fast. Your birthday present！
This is lovely, isn't it？ I love it. I'll treasure it？
...Thank you. Are you testing my taste with this？
(Doesn't look like she liked it much...)
So, once again. Happy birthday, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Thank you. Hey, I hope this becomes our tradition forever？
Next is your birthday. After that, my birthday.
Yes. And like that, you and I grow older...
And before we know it, we're a grandpa and grandma.
Don't you think that's a wonderful plan？
Hehe！ Let's stay close so it goes according to plan, okay？
Today's your birthday, right, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ Here, a present.
Of course！ Go on, open it.
I never expected to get something this lovely... Thank you.
Your taste is... No, never mind. Thank you.
(Doesn't look like she liked it much...)
Thank you for going to the trouble of getting me a present. It surprised me.
No, not at all. I'm happy about the present, but I'm happier you want to celebrate my birthday.
Next time it's my turn to make you happy, right？
Yes. When you're made happy, you pass it right back. And we keep doing it for each other.
It's the rule for being happy. Love or things, just receiving isn't enough.
Right？ If you're happy too, pass it back to me again, okay？
...Just kidding！ Thank you so much for the present. I'll treasure it？
(Oh no！ It's ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s birthday, and I didn't get her anything...)
Hello. Hey, you just frowned when you saw me... Why？
...Really？ Looks like you don't need me or have anything to say, so I'll go？
(I'm the biggest idiot in the world！)
(Oh no！ It's ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s birthday, and I didn't get her anything...)
▲主人公＊▲. Hey, you look pale... Are you okay？
Y-Yeah. Um, ▲高嶺＊＊▲... I kind of slipped up today, and, um...
...It's okay. You noticed, and that's enough. ...Don't worry？
(I'm the biggest idiot in the world！)
(Oh no！ It's ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s birthday, and I didn't get her anything...)
...You were the one I wanted to celebrate with most... Dummy.
(I'm the biggest idiot in the world！)
(Come to think of it, today's ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s birthday...)
▲主人公＊▲. What's wrong？ Spacing out in a place like this.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ looked disappointed... I should have gotten something ready...)
Today's the anniversary of when we started going out...
When I remember that time, my heart still pounds.
Me too. It's an important anniversary...
Um... Actually, I got you a present...
Lovely... A perfect gift for our anniversary. Thank you. I'll treasure it？
Hehe, this kind of thing is nice too, isn't it？ Thank you.
Thank you... It'll be memorable in a different way...
(Doesn't look like she liked it much...)
I can't wait for our next anniversary.
Yes, because I want to celebrate every year. Even if it's tempting fate. Hehe.
(A year from now, I want to be laughing like this with ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
Today's the anniversary of when we started going out. Thank you for being with me this year too.
This day exists because you accepted me. So I'm the one who should say thanks...
Stop. In that case, this day exists because ▲高嶺＊＊▲ was brave enough. Right？
...Hehe, I see. Okay, I won't say it anymore.
Hey, um... I got you a present...？
I'm so happy... I'll treasure it forever and ever？ Thank you...
Yes, it's cute... I guess？ Um, thank you...
(Doesn't look like she liked it much...)
I hope we can keep celebrating like this every year...
I'm sure lovers grow by building up moments like this...
(All right, I'll do my best this next year too！)
It's here, isn't it？ Our special day. The day we started going out.
It is. I'm happy we're together.
Hehe. Next year, the year after, and forever after, we'll be together？ Surely.
Hey, I got you a present. Did you？
Hehe, it's perfect, isn't it？ Thank you, I'll treasure it！
They have things like this... How fresh. Thank you.
Um... Yes, I'll keep it properly？ It's a memento.
(Doesn't look like she liked it much...)
We can celebrate like today next year too, right？
Of course. Not just next year, but the year after, and the one after that.
(Oh no. Isn't today the anniversary of when ▲高嶺＊＊▲ and I started going out？)
▲主人公＊▲. Do you remember what day it is today？
O-Of course I remember？ I remember, but, um...
...Hehe！ You're always so bad at lying, aren't you？
(She left... Of course she's mad. Sorry, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
(Oh no. Isn't today the anniversary of when ▲高嶺＊＊▲ and I started going out？)
▲主人公＊▲. Do you happen to remember what day it is today？
Huh, yes. I remember. I do. It's just, um... I didn't get anything ready...
...I see. So I was the only one looking forward to it... Sorry, I got the wrong idea. ...Bye.
(She left... Of course she's mad. Sorry, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
(Oh no. Isn't today the anniversary of when ▲高嶺＊＊▲ and I started going out？)
▲主人公＊▲. What day is it today？
▲高嶺＊＊▲. About that... Could we push it back to tomorrow？ I, um, didn't get anything ready...
...Anniversaries aren't something you push back, are they？
But in a way, this made it memorable... Maybe this is enough for this year？ ...Then, I'll go？
(She left... Of course she's mad. Sorry, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
